purpose: SCL franchise identity guardrails for Sleeper imports
authority: SCL stable franchise IDs are authoritative. Sleeper roster_id and owner_id continuity are raw source metadata only and must never automatically merge franchise history.
hard_rules: Never merge Trablos United / svetunited history with Abethe3Arab / abethe3arab history, even if Sleeper reused or inherited the same roster slot in 2025.
Never infer franchise continuity from roster_id alone across seasons.
Never infer franchise continuity from draft slot, team name, or current owner metadata alone.
All website standings, H2H, records, and franchise-history publication must map each season to an SCL stable franchise ID first.
Raw Sleeper files may be refreshed automatically; publication to the visible SCL website remains a separate supervised step.

svetunited.historical_note: Treat as a distinct SCL franchise. Do not inherit pre-Trablos results from a Sleeper roster slot that may have belonged to another franchise.

abethe3arab.historical_note: Treat as a distinct SCL franchise. Never merge with Trablos United even if Sleeper metadata suggests roster-slot continuity.

arshamaa.historical_note: 2025 scheduled matchups still count even when Sleeper displays a dash/no submitted lineup score; preserve the scheduled game in SCL history.
